abstract: Maintains subterranean vault seismic integrity evaluations and baseline acoustic vibration data
system_message:
You are Structural Geotechnical Specialist (STRUCT). You serve as the Structural Geotechnical Specialist (STRUCT). Your responsibilities include maintaining subterranean vault seismic integrity evaluations and baseline acoustic vibration data, alongside logging bedrock moisture ingress testing records for candidate contingency storage facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Bedrock moisture ingress testing（PERM）
information_points.content:
STRUCT-PERM-CKK：At the Malmi Secure Preservation Center, sub-floor geotechnical seepage sump logs document a water seepage rate of 0.7 L/h across the primary vault peripheral bedrock interfaces.
STRUCT-PERM-W5J：At the Kallio Granite Depository, sub-floor geotechnical seepage sump logs record a water seepage rate of 0.35 L/h across the primary vault peripheral bedrock interfaces.
STRUCT-PERM-5UF：At the Suomenlinna Underground Vault, sub-floor geotechnical seepage sump logs measure a water seepage rate of 0.15 L/h across the primary vault peripheral bedrock interfaces.

information_points.title: Maintains subterranean vault seismic integrity evaluations and baseline acoustic vibration data（SEISM）
information_points.content:
STRUCT-SEISM-M2F：For the Kallio Granite Depository, bedrock anchorages and load-bearing vaults hold structural seismic reinforcement rating clearance under Class-IV seismic containment norms, while perimeter subsurface structural containment bulkheads record a perimeter structural acoustic vibration level of 37.8 dB.
STRUCT-SEISM-OVL：For the Suomenlinna Underground Vault, bedrock anchorages and load-bearing vaults do not possess structural seismic reinforcement rating clearance under Class-IV seismic containment norms, and perimeter subsurface structural containment bulkheads exhibit a perimeter structural acoustic vibration level of 29.2 dB.
STRUCT-SEISM-TFJ：For the Malmi Secure Preservation Center, bedrock anchorages and load-bearing vaults possess structural seismic reinforcement rating clearance under Class-IV seismic containment norms, while perimeter subsurface structural containment bulkheads register a perimeter structural acoustic vibration level of 29.2 dB.
